title: A default letter temperature per question type (Gemma 4 12B Q8_0, zero-shot letters)
readout: z = option-letter log-probabilities from llama-server's top-200 list, a missing letter floored at (lowest listed - 2) (tez/backends.py letters_from_response; every input used n_probs 200 and this floor); options that left a tournament = -inf (tez/engine.py letter_logits); p = softmax(z / T) (tez/readout.py softmax_rows). Probability-only files: z = log p, which tempers identically.

protocol.unit: task = dataset/benchmark; MASSIVE (51 languages) and XNLI (10) one task each; JevBench's three tiers one task; each of Laya's seven application workflows one task; typed-decisions one task (split into its workflows as a variant)
protocol.types: question type as served: noul, choice, score (SemIf and voice option sets are choice questions)
protocol.option_count_buckets: choice only: 2, 3-5, 6-10, 11-26 options; a tournament (> 26 options) goes by its number of finalists, the options the tempered softmax actually spans (a variant puts it in its own > 26 bucket)
protocol.pooled_fit: argmin over T in [0.05, 20] of the mean NLL (p clipped at 1e-12) of all decisions in the cell, each decision weighing the same (task-balanced pools as a variant); tez.readout.T_GRID then golden-section refinement in log T
protocol.leave_one_task_out: for each cell and each task in it: T fitted on every other task's decisions of the cell, applied to the held-out task's; a cell with no other task falls back to the type's held-out T
protocol.oracle: T fitted on the task's own decisions of the type (in-sample; reference only)

settings.b': held-out pooled T per type, choice by option-count bucket (2, 3-5, 6-10, 11-26; tournament by finalists)
settings.r: held-out pooled T per type, choice split at 10 options (2-10, 11-26; tournament by finalists)

protocol.metrics: accuracy; ECE-15 = tez.readout.ece (max probability vs correctness, 15 equal-width bins (lo, hi]); NLL = tez.readout.nll; Brier = sum over options of (p - onehot)^2; score: |sum(i p_i) - gold level| (and squared)
protocol.aggregates: macro = unweighted mean over tasks (or task x type cells); micro = all decisions pooled
